title: 9 Lies Your Phone Preaches Before You Open Your Bible
caption:
Before you pray, before you're even out of bed, your phone has already made its first argument of the day.

Nine lies, on repeat, dressed up as normal. None of them announce themselves as lies. That's how they get in.

Open your Bible before you open the app. Let the first sermon of the day be the real one.

#faith #phone #christianmen #digitaldiscipline #manofgod
